evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative directive with absolute scope ('entirely') carries urgent, negatively-valenced insistence — a forceful erasure command, not a calm request.
Categorical erasure imperative ('all knowledge') sustains the same urgent, negatively-valenced insistence as src-1 — high-arousal directive pressure.
Flat declarative registering absence — low arousal, negative valence; a settled, weary negation following the urgent directives above.
